metadata.description: Ali Emre Vezir's Claude Code mods

plugins.name: prompt-dock
plugins.description: A rail of your prompts above the input (hover to preview, click to jump), a dock beside the transcript, and quote-reply from any selected text

plugins.name: project-hop
plugins.description: Start Claude in a folder of projects, browse them above the prompt, then open a new session or continue a recent one without leaving the terminal
